purpose: Read-only city source research and bounded public-service validation.
assessment: No geometry query. The city-level ownership layer is a promising local geospatial source but cannot be treated as a safe parcel feed without an inspectable field list and privacy review.
rootAssessment: Direct anonymous layer-schema GET timed out before a response, public Geoportal static JavaScript review did not expose a usable geometry-only route, and the national CKAN metadata request returned HTTP 403. Native identity, geometry type and safe output fields could not be verified through an accessible live layer schema; no feature query was made.
